game.title: Spark Shop: Idle Repair Empire
error: Something went wrong. Your bench is safe; try again.
adFailed: No video this time. Please try again shortly.
bench.note: A little solder. A second chance.
bench.hint: Tap a station to start a repair cycle.
boost.note: A little extra spark for the next big thing.
supply.choice: Collect one drop: free or video ×3.
fault.hint: Tap the glowing component in 3 seconds!
fault.wait: Keep an eye on the circuit board.
zones.note: New eras multiply every workshop’s income. Old benches keep working.
research.note: Spend permanent Badges. Eight ranks per branch. Crew rank 4 automates the opening bench after prestige.
prestige.title: A name the whole street knows
prestige.note: Reset cash, stations, managers and era access. Keep research, Badges, boosts, achievements and Reputation.
prestige.worth: A strong fresh start. A gain of 50 Reputation doubles your base permanent multiplier.
prestige.wait: Build your name a little longer. Wait for at least 50 new Reputation for a stronger reset.
prestige.confirm: Reset the workshops and collect the displayed Reputation?
offline.title: The crew kept the lights on
offline.note: Managed benches earned while you were away.
login.note: A seven-day cycle of small wins. No penalty for missed days.
event.note.0: Warm boards, busy benches. Income ×2 and extra Fault Hunt bonuses.
event.note.1: The neighbors brought their broken gadgets. Income ×1.25.
event.note.2: The night crew is on a roll. Managed income ×1.5.
shop.note: Permanent ×1.5 income, automatic welcome-back ×2, automatic two-hour boost on check-in, automatic supply collection. Optional videos stay available in the shop.
shop.notConfigured: The store is not configured yet.
lucky.note: Equal chance: 1 Badge, 10 min ×2 boost, or 10 min of income. At most two per day. Unlocks in the second era.
skip.note: Time skips unlock after your first prestige.
settings.reset.confirm: Erase local game progress? Purchases can be restored.
settings.notification.denied: Notifications were not enabled. You can change this in device settings.
settings.privacy.none: Privacy options are not required for this session.
settings.policy.missing: The publisher’s privacy policy URL will be added before release.
settings.local: Progress and analytics stay on this device. Export a save before changing devices.
age.title: Before we light up the bench
age.note: Choose your age group to set age-appropriate advertising privacy. This game is intended for ages 13 and up.
notification.cap: Spark Shop · Your bench reached its offline cap
notification.daily: Spark Shop · New daily repair jobs are ready
tutorial.title: Welcome to the bench
tutorial.0: Tap Repair on your first station. Repairs pay shop cash when the cycle finishes.
tutorial.1: Buy another station level. Try ×1, ×10, ×100 or MAX. More levels mean more income.
tutorial.2: Hire a manager to keep a station working, including while you are away.
tutorial.3: Watch the circuit board. A glowing faulty component gives a bonus if tapped in 3 seconds.
tutorial.4: Optional videos accelerate progress. Each button shows its reward. All eras are reachable for free.
